_comment: Trusted TRC-20 contracts the firmware clear-signs transfers for. Add a token only with its issuer's own publication of the mainnet address, and symbol/decimals read from the contract itself (symbol(), decimals()). Symbols must be unique: a second contract under a known label could pass as the real token. Excluded on purpose: USDD OLD (TPYmHEhy5n8TCEfYGqW2rPxsghSfzghPDn, same on-chain symbol as USDD 2.0, superseded) and USDC (Circle ended TRON support).
